place.name: The Arctic Fox Centre
place.description: The Arctic Fox Centre (Icelandic: Melrakkasetur Íslands [ˈmɛlˌrahkaˌsɛːtʏr̥]) is a research centre with an enclosed exhibition and café in the municipality Súðavík in the Westfjords in Iceland. It focuses on the Arctic fox (Vulpes lagopus) which is the only native terrestrial mammal in Iceland.
